### Observed differences

- A08 appears in about 30 of 100 cases in the later window, up from about 13 of 100 earlier, and it now occurs earlier within the case (mean relative position about 0.34 versus 0.49). [OCC001, POS001]
- A19, A20 and A25 now lead almost exclusively to A26: in the later window A26 receives all 69 observed outgoing transitions of A19 and about 96–97 in 100 of those of A20 and A25, whereas earlier roughly half of each activity's outgoing transitions went to A28 and half to A32 (for example A19: A28 about 52 in 100, A32 about 44 in 100). [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004]
- The same three activities run much earlier than before, directly adjacent to A26: their mean relative position moved from about 0.59–0.61 to about 0.32–0.33, and A26 follows A19 one step later in all 69 later observations, whereas earlier this pair was seen only once and four steps apart. [POS002, POS003, POS004, LAG007]
- A45 no longer goes straight to A26: earlier about 92 in 100 of its outgoing transitions led to A26, in the later window under 1 in 100 do, and A20 (about 26%), A08 (about 25%), A25 (about 23%) and A19 (about 23%) follow it instead; the gap from A45 to A26 widened from usually one step to two or three. [DIR007, LAG014]
- A08 feeds the same group: its outgoing transitions, previously spread over many activities (A16, A26, A15 and A49 at about 14 in 100 each), now go mainly to A19 (about 38 in 100), A20 (about 29) and A25 (about 21), and A26 then follows two steps after A08 in about 96 in 100 later observations. [DIR001, LAG002]
- The earlier entries into A19, A20 and A25 have practically disappeared: A27 now leads to A28 in about 98 in 100 of its transitions (earlier about 50, with roughly 15% each to A19, A20 and A25), A28 leads to A32 in about 99 in 100 (earlier about 48, with about 14–21% to A19, A20 and A25), and the pairs A27→A25, A28→A25 and A25→A32, seen in 41–72 cases earlier, now appear in only 1–2 cases. [DIR005, DIR006, LAG008, LAG009, LAG012]
- The remaining chain A27→A28→A32 became tight and one step shorter to A32: both steps now occur at a gap of one in about 98–99 in 100 cases (earlier roughly half at a gap of one and half at two), and A32 follows A27 two steps later in about 97 in 100 cases versus three steps in about 96 in 100 earlier. [LAG010, LAG011, LAG013]
- A26 still occurs in every case in both windows but slightly later on average (mean relative position about 0.35 versus 0.32), and its gaps from A16 and A18 grew (typically four to five steps after A16 versus three; three to four after A18 versus two). [POS005, LAG004, LAG005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the activities A19, A20 and A25 were re-routed to run immediately before A26. In the earlier window they formed a mid-to-late detour entered from A27 or A28 and leading back to A28 or A32; in the later window they are entered from A45 or A08 and each leads directly to A26, so that A45 reaches A26 only through one of them, while A27, A28 and A32 run as a direct, almost fixed chain and A08 — now present in about 30 of 100 cases — acts as an additional feeder of the group. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, OCC001]

The rerouting is shown directly by the successor profiles, which changed on both sides with substantial support (61–73 outgoing transitions per window for A19, A20 and A25; about 200 for A27, A28 and A45), and by the lag evidence showing both the new immediate successions (A19→A26, A08→A19) and the dissolved ones (A45→A26, A28→A25, A25→A32); the position distributions of A19, A20 and A25 moved from about 0.6 to about 0.32, next to A26. With 30 qualifying control-flow items against about 0.67 expected without a change, the set as a whole is unlikely to be a sampling artefact. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, LAG001, LAG007, LAG008, LAG012, LAG014, POS002, POS003, POS004]

Limitations: the before-window evidence behind the new links is thin (A19→A26 and A08→A19 were each seen only once before), so these links may have existed at very low frequency earlier and been taken up rather than newly created; several items describe the same underlying trace behaviour and are not independent confirmations; and the evidence cannot show whether A08's increased participation drove the rerouting or followed from it. [LAG001, LAG007, OCC001]

Other differences: A26 occurs slightly later on average (mean relative position about 0.35 versus 0.32, still in every case), and the gaps from A16 and from A18 to A26 lengthened by about one to two steps. [POS005, LAG004, LAG005]
